column1: # portfolio.tsv — the registry of every repo the control plane is allowed to touch.
# ONE ROW PER REPO. This is the single source of truth for repo -> deploy key, which until now
# lived only in whoever typed the command; a git op run with the wrong key returns EMPTY, and an
# empty answer reads exactly like a true negative. resync.sh reads this so no caller has to
# remember, and work.sh falls back to it when a task omits sshkey:.
# status: active    = synced every cycle AND dispatchable
#         reference = synced (so it is never lost) but NEVER dispatched at
#         pending   = registered, not yet cloned/created — skipped by sync, refused by check
# topic = telegram forum thread id for this project (B7 fills these; '-' until then).
# Tab-separated. Do not align with spaces — the columns are read with cut -f.
